definitions.explanation: The rhythmic beating of arteries as blood is pumped through them by the heart. Measured as beats per minute and used as a basic health indicator.

examples.japanese: {脈拍|みゃくはく}を{測|はか}る。
{運動|うんどう}すると{脈拍|みゃくはく}が{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: Your pulse goes up when you exercise.

examples.japanese: {看護師|かんごし}が{患者|かんじゃ}の{脈拍|みゃくはく}と{血圧|けつあつ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: The nurse checked the patient's pulse and blood pressure.

notes:
USAGE:
{脈拍|みゃくはく} is the standard medical/formal term for pulse. In casual speech, {脈|みゃく} alone is often sufficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脈拍|みゃくはく}を{測|はか}る (to measure one's pulse)
- {脈拍|みゃくはく}が{速|はや}い / {遅|おそ}い (pulse is fast / slow)
- {脈拍|みゃくはく}{数|すう} (pulse rate)
- {安静時|あんせいじ}{脈拍|みゃくはく} (resting pulse)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脈|みゃく}: pulse — shorter form, used more casually
- {心拍|しんぱく}: heartbeat — specifically the beating of the heart itself
- {心拍数|しんぱくすう}: heart rate — numerical measurement
